omitted_in_database: draft and needs_adjudication records are not labels
notes: This is the full human-confirmed set, not a quality ranking.
Labels describe the frozen 384 x 256 input, not the original photo.
Confirmed by a human after seeing the frozen vendor boxes: assisted review, not independent blind annotation.
Eyes without a visible boundary are exported as 12 x 12 boxes flagged eye_center_boxed; that size is a container, not a measured eye.
12 confirmed images are folded out of the annotation queue by the similarity grouping; in_queue keeps that visible instead of dropping them.
